repos.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
repos.intro: Agents can retrieve documents and query databases, but reliability gates agentic analytics: a revenue metric answered faster is worth nothing if the number is wrong. Agents need a context layer that tells them where data lives, what it means, whether to use it, how to use it, where it came from, and what is similar.
features: Natural-language querying of structured data — questions are translated to SQL and executed against connected databases, powered by NVIDIA N…
Semantic catalog / ontology layer over relational sources, stored in Postgres alongside the catalog it describes.
Authentication & RBAC —using Better Auth .
Web UI for chat, analysis, data catalog, analytics, and settings.
Flexible deployment — Helm chart for Kubernetes or Docker Compose for a local stack.
repos.description_zh: Auto Ontology 是一個 Python framework，用於在數據之上構建語義化、基於圖（graph-based）的推理層。它能實現確定性的查詢生成、更好的上下文檢索，並為 LLM 與 agent 工作流提供更具可解釋性的 AI。
repos.intro_zh: Agents 可以檢索文件並查詢資料庫，但可靠性是限制 agentic analytics 的關鍵：如果營收指標的回答速度很快但數字錯誤，那將毫無價值。Agents 需要一個上下文層來告訴它們數據儲存在哪裡、代表什麼意義、是否應該使用、如何使用、來源為何，以及哪些數據是相似的。
features_zh: 結構化數據的自然語言查詢 —— 問題會被轉換為 SQL 並在連接的資料庫上執行，由 NVIDIA N… 提供動力。
位於關聯式來源之上的語義目錄 / ontology 層，與其描述的目錄一同儲存在 Postgres 中。
Authentication & RBAC —— 使用 Better Auth。
用於聊天、分析、數據目錄、分析與設定的 Web UI。
靈活的部署方式 —— 提供用於 Kubernetes 的 Helm chart 或用於本地 stack 的 Docker Compose。
repos.description_src: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.

repos.intro: LZ4 is a lossless compression algorithm, providing compression speed > 500 MB/s per core, scalable with multi-core CPUs. It features an extremely fast decoder, with speed in multiple GB/s per core, typically reaching RAM speed limits on multi-core systems.
repos.intro_zh: LZ4 是一種無損壓縮演算法，每個核心可提供 > 500 MB/s 的壓縮速度，並可隨多核心 CPU 進行擴展。其特點是擁有極快的解碼器，每個核心的速度可達數 GB/s，在多核心系統上通常能達到 RAM 的速度極限。

repos.description: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
repos.intro: A curated collection of production-ready Agent Skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and other AI coding agents.
features: Deterministic render(t) pipeline : stills, contact sheets, three-direction boards, proxies and masters all come from the same page.
One timeline for picture and sound : cuts, hits and SFX share the same numbers.
A 43-style library as a starting point : swiss-editorial, ink-wash, risograph, synthwave, soft 3D, cinematic title, pixel game, comic panels…
A sound direction, not a default song : the brief sets a sound benchmark, groove, harmony, palette and dramatic arc, plus a list of audio de…
Two checkpoints : confirm requirements, then style frames (three distinct directions when unspecified), followed by autonomous production.
Narration and long films : Gemini/MiniMax TTS reads only user-supplied scripts; recordings use real timestamps.
repos.description_zh: ConardLi 的開源 Skills 集合，包含網頁設計、知識檢索、圖像生成等功能。
repos.intro_zh: 為 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 及其他 AI coding agents 精選的生產就緒型 Agent Skills 集合。
features_zh: 決定性渲染 (render(t)) 管線：靜態圖、聯集照 (contact sheets)、三向構圖板 (three-direction boards)、代理檔 (proxies) 與母檔 (masters) 皆出自同一個頁面。
影音同步的單一時間軸：剪輯點 (cuts)、節拍點 (hits) 與音效 (SFX) 共用相同的數值。
以 43 風格庫作為起點：瑞士編輯風格 (swiss-editorial)、水墨、孔版印刷 (risograph)、合成器波 (synthwave)、柔和 3D、電影標題、像素遊戲、漫畫分鏡……
是聲音方向，而非預設歌曲：需求簡報 (brief) 設定了聲音基準、律動 (groove)、和聲、色調 (palette) 與戲劇弧線 (dramatic arc)，外加一份音訊描述清單……
兩個檢查點：確認需求，接著製作風格框 (style frames)（若未指定則提供三個截然不同的方向），隨後進行自主製作。
旁白與長片：Gemini/MiniMax TTS 僅朗讀使用者提供的腳本；錄音使用真實的時間戳記 (timestamps)。
repos.description_src: ConardLi's open-source Skills collection, featuring web design, knowledge retrieval, image generation, and more.
